{{DISPLAYTITLE:vaspwave.h5}}
The {{FILE|vaspwave.h5}} file is the hdf5 counterpart of the {{FILE|WAVECAR}} and {{FILE|CHGCAR}} and other files used inside a more elaborate workflow, like for instance GW. 
This file is written if {{TAG|LH5}}=.TRUE. is set in the {{FILE|INCAR}} file.
{{NB|mind|As of version 6.6.0 this files stores optionally following datasets.}}

* energies and orbitals from {{FILE|WAVECAR}}
* charge density from {{FILE|CHGCAR}}
* optical transition elements from {{FILE|WAVEDER}}
* Wannier projection matrices {{FILE|WANPROJ}}
* local potential {{FILE|POT}}
